test_title: PYST 32: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 11 Aug, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Fervour
solution: The correct answer is: **Enthusiasm**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Fervour **means intense and passionate feeling or enthusiasm. (तीव्र और भावुक भावना या उत्साह) • **Example**: *Her speech was delivered with such fervour that it inspired everyone in the audience.* • Marked option **Enthusiasm **is a synonym for fervour and means intense excitement or enjoyment. (तीव्र उत्तेजना या आनंद) • **Example**: *She showed great fervour while playing her favourite sport.* Therefore, the correct answer is **option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • **Apathy **means a lack of interest or emotion. (रुचि या भावना की कमी) • **Hatred **means intense dislike or hostility. (तीव्र नापसंदगी या शत्रुता) • **Disgust **means a feeling of revulsion or profound disapproval towards something. (किसी चीज़ के प्रति घृणा या गहरी अस्वीकृति की भावना) 46:T86e, The correct answer is: **Procrastinate**.
